page.overview:
What is West Sea?

The is one of the Four Seas, the body of water surrounding the Eastern Continent. It is the domain of Ao Run, the Dragon King of the Western Sea.

After being unable to find a teacher on the Southern Continent, Sun Wukong made a raft and sailed across the West Sea until he reached the Western Continent.
